newsitem.title: USA: ThermoGenesis closes on $8.3 mln placement. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: ThermoGenesis closes on $8.3 mln placement. [CORRECTED]

text.p: ThermoGenesis Corp said Wednesday it completed a private placement of about 1.4 million units (corrects from 1.7 million units), securing gross funds of about $8.27 million.
Allen & Co Inc managed the placement.
Proceeds will go to developing two lead pipeline products and be used for working capital as well.
Each unit sold consisted of two common shares, plus one warrant to buy an additional share of common stock for a period of seven years, the company detailed.
